problem: A configurable extension host is incomplete when its definition type is added without the same owner-owned value lifecycle, generated contract, form input, durable readback, formal fixture coverage, and every approved detail read projection as existing hosts.
counterexampleBoundary: Existing hosts retain their current owners and UI paths; this package neither introduces a generic cross-owner value writer nor changes unrelated organization types.
minimalRepair: Extend the existing definition/value model at the owning commercial-group and hierarchy services, expose it through generated edge contracts, and reuse one operations organization-extension field renderer for region/project form and detail paths. Reuse the generated platform definition query to map the commercial-group root readback in the platform hierarchy; keep region/project detail mapping owner-side. Seed through owner HTTP commands and assert owner readback.
preventionDestination: U26 focused owner/contract/codegen/UI tests cover all three hierarchy details; the fresh r5-full owner-command seed covers durable owner facts.
